about: Recurring checks of public Scrolls, run by python3 -m kit routines (kit/routines.py) from any agent or account: the Claude Code SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json runs the due ones, docs/AI-AGENTS.md tells Codex, ChatGPT and other agents to run python3 -m kit routines run --due at session start, and the daily workflow .github/workflows/routines.yml runs the ones marked ci on GitHub's free runners. Results go to the ignored work/routines/. Routines only check: they never post, comment, open issues, upload, push or start Modal. Exit codes: 0 ok, 3 attention, 75 skipped, other fail.

routines.name: prize-page
routines.why: docs/AI-AGENTS.md rule 4: re-check prizes, and add a new dated snapshot in kit/data when the live page changes

routines.name: prizes
routines.why: AGENTS.md Commands: the open prizes and days left from the dated snapshot

routines.name: releases
routines.why: AGENTS.md rule 15: the README's Released tools section and docs/releases.json agree

routines.name: leaderboard
routines.why: the ink reader leaderboard page and docs/results.json stay in step (runs once kit leaderboard lands)

routines.name: stale
routines.why: docs/HANDOFF.md, row Rules relaxed and decisions file (18 Oct 2026): a staleness check at session start. Live pages and registries that no longer hold: handoff rows unchanged for a week, gone or quietly merged branches, retired names (docs/renames.json), dead links, docs/MAP.md rows, waiting routines (kit/stale.py). In the workflow's depth-1 checkout the branch check skips and every line dates to the tip commit, so an age finding appears there only after that many days without a commit

routines.name: autopipeline-watch
routines.why: AGENTS.md Commands, scheduled: queue new or changed open-data bucket volumes, priced in dry run (exit 3 when something is new); it launches nothing (kit/autobatch.py). Not in the workflow: a runner keeps no state, so every volume would look new

routines.name: handoff
routines.why: AGENTS.md rule 14: one current handoff; AGENTS.md and docs/HANDOFF.md stay under tests/test_repo.py's limits

routines.name: repo-tests
routines.why: tests/test_repo.py: size limits, no long dashes, relative links, every kit module in docs/MAP.md, documented kit commands exist (the workflow runs the whole suite instead)
